title: Tekkit Classic Rubber Farming
description: Makes IC2 rubber stand out more
body:
Makes the IC2 rubber log look like this when it's ready to harvest. Makes it a lot easier to spot them when they're hidden among hundreds of others.

![Two rubber logs floating in the air with a red arrow pointing from the left one to the right one. The left log is a normal IC2 rubber log with a spot of harvestable rubber on its left face. The right log looks exactly the same, except for its left face, which is completely orange rather than having just a small spot of orange like the left log.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/hmaU4Hrq/images/3f1fd060d5460980830c8eec595da3d09c95c586.png)
